key_insight: Functions represented by irreducible shallow tanh networks with n hidden neurons form a smooth embedded manifold in Sobolev spaces, with exactly n+1 connected components for scalar input and output and one component otherwise.
engineering_relevance: The result provides a rigorous geometric foundation for analyzing fixed-width shallow tanh function spaces, rather than a demonstrated improvement in training performance.
method: Study fixed-width shallow tanh networks without redundant neurons in Sussmann’s sense.
Prove parameter boundedness when network functions converge in Sobolev norm to an irreducible network of the same width.
Establish smooth embeddedness in W^{ℓ,p} on bounded sets and characterize connected components.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical proofs for any ℓ∈ℕ and p∈[1,∞], with no datasets or empirical evaluations described.
watch_item: The manifold guarantee applies to irreducible, fixed-width shallow tanh networks; redundant neurons and other architectures fall outside the stated result.
paper_title: Irreducible shallow tanh neural networks are a manifold
